newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ENGLISH F.A. CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ENGLISH F.A. CUP FINAL.

text.p: Line-ups for the English F.A. Cup Final between Chelsea and Middlesbrough at Wembley Stadium on Saturday:

Chelsea: 30-Frode Grodas; 17-Scott Minto, 6-Steve Clarke, 5-Frank Lebouef, 20-Frank Sinclair, 2-Dan Petrescu, 24-Eddie Newton, 16-Roberto di Matteo, 11-Dennis Wise, 10-Mark Hughes, 25-Gianfranco Zola.

Middlesbrough: 25-Ben Roberts; 14-Curtis Fleming, 5-Nigel Pearson, 18-Gianluca Festa, 17-Clayton Blackmore, 11-Fabrizio Ravanelli, 8-Robbie Mustoe, 6-Emerson, 21-Craig Hignett, 10-Juninho, 20-Phil Stamp.
